mapper.sql: (select concat(F.upload_path, '/s_', F.file_name, '_', F.file_dname, F.file_ext) from Auct_FileUpload F where F.anum = A.anum order by F.sort_no, F.fnum limit 1) as thumb
mapper.select: select A.anum, A.unum, A.prod_title, A.prod_name, A.start_amt, A.join_cnt, A.join_amt, A.limit_type, A.limit_amt, A.auct_start, A.auct_end, A.end_chk, A.win_unum, A.win_amt, A.end_date, J.my_max, J.my_cnt, J.last_bid, from ( select anum, max(volume) as my_max, count(*) as my_cnt, max(join_created) as last_bid from Auct_Master_join where unum = #{unum} and cancel_chk = 'N' group by anum ) J inner join Auct_Master A on A.anum = J.anum order by J.last_bid desc
select A.*, U.name as other_name, U.phone as other_phone, U.email as other_email, from Auct_Master A inner join User_List U on U.unum = A.unum where A.win_unum = #{unum} order by A.end_date desc

select A.*, W.name as other_name, W.phone as other_phone, W.email as other_email, W.name as win_name,
from Auct_Master A left join User_List W on W.unum = A.win_unum where A.unum = #{unum} order by A.anum desc
select count(*) from Auct_Master where unum = #{unum} and end_chk = 'N'
select count(distinct A.anum) from Auct_Master A inner join Auct_Master_join J on J.anum = A.anum and J.unum = #{unum} and J.cancel_chk = 'N' where A.end_chk = 'N' and J.volume = A.start_amt
